title: BPA for Crane and Heavy Forklift Rental Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > NGB > W7MT USPFO ACTIVITY AL ARNG
description:
This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. 

 Solicitation number W912JA27QA002 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ) for Commercial Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) for statewide, multi-zone Mobile Hydraulic Crane and Heavy Forklift Rental Services with Operators. North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 532412, Construction, Mining, and Forestry Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing, with a small business size standard of $40,000,000.00. 

 This acquisition is   set-aside for 100% small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. All vendors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) with an active CAGE Code and Unique Entity Identifier (UEI). 

  The following are the list of line items and descriptions requested under this RFQ . 

 CLIN 0001: Mobile Crane, 30–40 Ton (with NCCCO Certified Operator) – Estimated QTY: 400 Hours 

 CLIN 0002: Mobile Crane, 50–65 Ton (with NCCCO Certified Operator) – Estimated QTY: 400 Hours 

 CLIN 0003: Mobile Crane, 75–90 Ton (with NCCCO Certified Operator) – Estimated QTY: 300 Hours 

 CLIN 0004: Mobile Crane, 100–120 Ton (with NCCCO Certified Operator) – Estimated QTY: 200 Hours 

 CLIN 0005: Warehouse Forklift, 5,000–6,000 lbs. (Solid/Pneumatic with OSHA Certified Operator) – Estimated QTY: 500 Hours 

 CLIN 0006: Rough Terrain / Telehandler Forklift, 10,000–12,000 lbs. (with OSHA Certified Operator) – Estimated QTY: 500 Hours 

 CLIN 0007: Heavy Industrial Forklift, 15,000–25,000 lbs. (with OSHA Certified Operator) – Estimated QTY: 400 Hours 

 CLIN 0008: Heavy Cargo / Container Handler, 30,000–50,000+ lbs. (with OSHA Certified Operator) – Estimated QTY: 200 Hours 

 CLIN 0009: Mobilization / Demobilization (Round-Trip per Call Order) – Flat one-time fee per order covering delivery, DOT overweight/oversize permits, and escort/pilot cars to/from ALARNG training site. Zone 1: 0–35 Miles (Local Metro: Birmingham, Montgomery, Mobile, Huntsville) – Estimated QTY: 50 Each 

 CLIN 0010: Mobilization / Demobilization (Round-Trip per Call Order) – Flat one-time fee. Zone 2: 36–75 Miles – Estimated QTY: 40 Each 

 CLIN 0011: Mobilization / Demobilization (Round-Trip per Call Order) – Flat one-time fee. Zone 3: 76–125 Miles – Estimated QTY: 30 Each 

 CLIN 0012: Mobilization / Demobilization (Round-Trip per Call Order) – Flat one-time fee. Zone 4: 126+ Miles (Statewide Extended) – Estimated QTY: 20 Each 

 CLIN 0013: Standby & Incidental Labor – Standby Hourly Rate (On-site idle time due to weather/training delay) – Estimated QTY: 30 Hours 

 CLIN 0014: Standby & Incidental Labor – Certified Rigger / Signal Person (Additional specialized labor when required by COR) – Estimated QTY: 40 Hours 

  Scope of Work & Operational Highlights  

 Ordering Period: Five (5) years from 28 December 2026 through 27 December 2031. Specific periods of performance and delivery dates will be designated on individual BPA Calls. Establishing a BPA does not obligate Government funds; funds are obligated solely upon issuance of funded call orders. 

 Minimum Billing Guarantee: Minimum guarantee per call (per CLIN) will be four (4) hours. Although a BPA Call may be issued for an estimated duration, the contractor shall invoice for actual hours used (rounded up to the nearest whole hour), subject to the 4-hour minimum. 

 Equipment & Safety Standards: All machinery must be in excellent mechanical condition conforming to manufacturer specifications and ANSI/ASME standards. Operational testing must be conducted before every lift. Third-party certified load testing (100% to 110% of anticipated load) is required when directed. The contractor must maintain a minimum of $100,000.00 in general liability insurance to cover property damage. 

 Accident Reporting: Accidents and near misses must be handled IAW the contractor's Accident Prevention Plan (APP). Property damage exceeding $5,000.00 or injuries/illnesses must be verbally reported to the Government POC within four (4) hours of the incident.

Submit all questions by 17 November 2026 at 16:00 CST. Quotes are due no later than 07 December 2026 at 16:00 CST via email. Quotes MUST be good for sixty (60) calendar days after submission. 

  SECURITY REQUIREMENTS  

 A. Work performed is UNCLASSIFIED. The Contractor during the performance under this contract shall comply with all applicable Department of Defense (DoD) security regulations and procedures. The Contractor shall coordinate with the P.O.C. all issues dealing with access to Government buildings, facilities, or property. 

 B. The Contractor will ensure that personnel have proper identification for entry or access to location.
